items.title: A Pipeline-Parallel System for Depth-Recurrent Models
items.summary: L'article partagé par Hugging Face traite du système de parallélisme de pipeline requis pour la mise à l'échelle des modèles récurrents en profondeur. Dans ces modèles, où les piles de blocs partagés sont utilisées plusieurs fois, une solution est proposée aux limites de la méthode 1F1B traditionnelle dans la gestion des flux de données cycliques.

snapshot.description: Depth-recurrent (Looped) models raise effective depth by applying a shared stack of blocks several times. Scaling them usually requires pipeline parallelism, but commonly used interleaved 1F1B is drawn for an acyclic stage graph in which each micro-batch enters each stage once. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. snapshot.description: Robot policies must adapt to the speed of moving objects, yet existing benchmarks rarely measure this ability across diverse tasks and speeds. We introduce SWEEP-Bench, a simulation benchmark with 80 conveyor-belt manipulation tasks spanning 16 skill categories, each evaluated at 13 belt speeds (0.10-0.40 m/s). items.title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience

snapshot.description: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. items.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: Embodied-Harness introduit un cadre à double agent qui améliore le processus d'exécution des tâches de manipulation robotique sans mettre à jour les paramètres du modèle. Il vise à surmonter les limites des agents basés sur un modèle de langage de vision dans la gestion de la mémoire et la répétition de l'expérience grâce à un mécanisme de réflecteur qui analyse les preuves d'exécution.

snapshot.description: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters.
